name: NearMissTriple.code-float-503.0
why: code 503.0 is a JSON float, not an integer; Python 503.0 == 503 is True, so a plain == matcher would wrongly accept it (CriticC1Overfit, RevengerEnvelopeHistory).

name: NearMissTriple.code-boolean-true
why: code true: bool is an int subclass in Python, so isinstance(code, int) alone would not reject it.

name: NearMissTriple.message-trailing-period
why: "Loading model." differs from the exact message by one byte; equality, not prefix or substring.

name: NearMissTriple.message-surrounding-space
why: " Loading model " must not be stripped into a match.

name: NearMissTriple.router-stream-owner-loading
why: Real b11755 router-only unavailable_error message (server-models.cpp:2585) contains 'loading' but is not the startup gate; a substring matcher would accept it.

error.message: Stream owner model is loading, retry later

name: NearMissTriple.empty-503
why: A content-less 503 (SGLang Starting /health shape) carries no envelope and stays on the generic path.

name: NearMissTriple.readme-key-order-positive
why: README@704366d:486 prints code,message,type order while the live server sends message,type,code; the parsed triple decides, not byte order.

name: NearMissTriple.exact-envelope-labelled-html
why: Exact JSON envelope served with Content-Type text/html: the rule keys on the parsed body at status 503, so it is MODEL_LOADING (pins the branch order before the HTML sniff).
